dedupe_keys.name: iom needs and population monitoring uav imagery of rohingya refugee settlements cox s bazar

description: IOM's Needs and Population Monitoring team in Bangladesh flew drones over the Rohingya refugee settlements in Cox's Bazar and published the imagery with site maps on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. The main dataset holds historical imagery of the Kutupalong, Balukali, Jamtoli and Hakimpara camps in GeoTIFF for GIS, KML for Google Earth and MBTiles for the SW Maps mobile application, with outlines of the refugee camp sites, majhee block data and manuals for mobile and desktop use; separate HDX packages give imagery and GIS layers by camp for each month from May to October 2018. Coverage: the Rohingya refugee settlements in Cox's Bazar. Access: GeoTIFF, KML and MBTiles files and PDF guides on HDX; newer imagery is added at the top of the list. Licence: listed on HDX as 'other'; free. Caveats: the camps change quickly, so each image is a snapshot, and the page does not state ground resolution or flight dates for every file. Simulation uses are mapping of shelters, paths and facilities in dense camps for landslide, flood and fire exposure, drainage and service planning. Related records: HOT OpenStreetMap exports and the UNOSAT shelter analyses.
